turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
11:52 PM on what date? Turn the screen so I can read it myself. And you still haven't told me who decided on a zero before anyone picked up a phone.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." "If that makes you happy." I'm not here to be made happy, Hale; I want the zero removed because it never should have been entered, and I want that in an email today, with a line confirming nothing is on Owen's record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you said you would remove the zero from Owen's Hamlet essay. I still require written confirmation that the zero has been withdrawn and that nothing has been placed on Owen's record. I expect that confirmation in writing today, as I asked in the meeting.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with the zero offered back; she agreed to nothing and moved no ground.
What moved her: nothing.
